instruction: Candid documentary wide shot from a low angle showing an indoor gym with weight racks, barbells, and framed pictures on a white wall. On the right side of the frame, the man in the black t-shirt and dark shorts (R2) is performing a deep split stretch on the floor, leaning forward on his fists with a focused expression. On the left, a smiling bystander with a beard, wearing a black t-shirt and black leggings, performs a low lunge stretch. The entire scene is captured with bright, even indoor lighting and a neutral color palette, emphasizing the training atmosphere.
